channel.title: HSM Kit Security Knowledge Base
channel.description: Technical guides to cryptography, HSM key management, payment security, PKI, and data encoding.

item.title: AES Test Vectors: Browser and Library Validation Lab
item.description: Reproduce NIST AES-128, AES-192, AES-256, ECB, and CBC known-answer vectors in CryptoJS, Web Crypto, and the HSM Kit browser tool.

item.title: AES-GCM vs AES-CBC: Which Mode Should You Use?
item.description: Compare AES-GCM and AES-CBC security, authentication, IV requirements, performance, and compatibility to choose the right encryption mode.

item.title: AES IV and Nonce Reuse: Risks & Prevention
item.description: Learn why IV and nonce reuse breaks AES-CBC, CTR, and GCM security, how to generate safe values, and how to design reliable nonce storage.

item.title: PKCS#7 Padding for AES: How It Works
item.description: Understand PKCS#7 padding byte by byte, including full-block padding, validation, common errors, and safe unpadding for AES-CBC.

item.title: Web Crypto AES-GCM: Browser Encryption Guide
item.description: Implement AES-GCM with the Web Crypto API using secure key generation, unique nonces, authenticated data, and portable ciphertext packaging.

item.title: Format-Preserving Encryption (FPE): FF1, FF3-1 & Tokenization
item.description: Learn how Format-Preserving Encryption works — FF1 and FF3-1 algorithms, tokenization of credit cards, PCI DSS compliance, and when to use FPE vs traditional encryption.

item.title: Character Encoding Explained: ASCII, EBCDIC, Hex & Binary
item.description: Understand character encoding fundamentals — ASCII table, EBCDIC in banking systems, hexadecimal and binary representations, and encoding compatibility issues.

item.title: BCD (Binary Coded Decimal): Packed, Unpacked & Financial Messages
item.description: A practical guide to BCD encoding — packed vs unpacked formats, usage in ISO 8583 financial messages, and conversion between BCD and hexadecimal.

item.title: Check Digits: Luhn Algorithm, Mod 10 & Validation Methods
item.description: How check digit algorithms work — Luhn formula step by step, Mod 10 and Mod 9 variants, credit card validation, and IMEI verification.

item.title: Base94 Encoding: Compact Data Representation
item.description: Understand Base94 encoding — how it differs from Base64, the full printable ASCII character set, compression efficiency, and practical use cases.

item.title: RSA DER Public Key: Format, Structure & Decoding
item.description: How RSA public keys are encoded — DER and PEM formats, ASN.1 structure, extracting Modulus and Exponent, PKCS#1 vs PKCS#8 differences.

item.title: SSL/TLS Certificates: X.509 Structure, Chain & Validation
item.description: A complete guide to SSL/TLS certificates — X.509 structure, certificate chains, self-signed certificates, CSR generation, and certificate validity.

item.title: UUID Generation: v1, v4, v5 & When to Use Each
item.description: Everything about UUIDs — version differences, randomness guarantees, collision probability, and choosing the right UUID version for databases and APIs.

item.title: Futurex HSM Key Management: MFK Variants & Key Schemes
item.description: How Futurex HSMs handle key encryption — MFK variants, key scheme formats (B, C, H, F, G), KCV verification, and key lookup operations.

item.title: Atalla AKB Key Block Format: Header, Encryption & Validation
item.description: Understanding the Atalla Key Block (AKB) format — header structure, MFK encryption, KCV validation, and how Atalla HSMs protect cryptographic keys.

item.title: SafeNet Key Management: Luna HSM & KM Key Variants
item.description: How SafeNet (Thales Luna) HSMs manage keys — KM key encryption, variant-based key lookup, and key transport between HSMs.

item.title: Thales LMK Key Encryption: Schemes, Variants & Key Types
item.description: A deep dive into Thales LMK-based key encryption — key scheme formats (ZMK, TMK, ZPK), variant encryption principles, and key block standards.

item.title: Thales Key Block Format: Header, TLV & TR-31 Comparison
item.description: Understanding Thales proprietary key block format — header fields, TLV structure, differences from TR-31, and practical encoding examples.

item.title: ISO 8583 Message Parser: MTI, Bitmap & Data Elements
item.description: How to parse ISO 8583 financial transaction messages — Message Type Indicator, bitmap decoding, data element definitions, and ATM NDC/Wincor formats.

item.title: AS2805: Australian Payment Standard for Terminal Keys & MAC
item.description: Understanding the AS2805 standard — terminal key set generation, PIN block translation, MAC calculation methods, and OWF (HMAC-SHA256).

item.title: AMEX CSC: Card Security Code Calculation (CSC3/CSC4/CSC5)
item.description: How American Express card security codes are calculated — CSC3, CSC4, CSC5 algorithms, differences from CVV, and AMEX-specific card characteristics.

item.title: Mastercard Dynamic CVC3: EMV Verification & ATC
item.description: Understanding Mastercard's dynamic CVC3 — EMV verification process, Application Transaction Counter (ATC), Unpredictable Number, and Track data usage.

item.title: DUKPT AES: Next-Generation Key Derivation for Payment Terminals
item.description: How AES-based DUKPT works — differences from TDEA-DUKPT, IK/BDK hierarchy, Working Key derivation, and migration from legacy DUKPT.

item.title: PIN Block AES (Format 4): ISO 9564 with AES Encryption
item.description: How ISO 9564 Format 4 PIN blocks work — AES encryption of PINs, comparison with Format 0, and implementation considerations.

item.title: PIN Offset (IBM 3624): PIN Verification & Decimalization
item.description: How IBM 3624 PIN verification works — Decimalization Table, PIN Offset calculation, validation methods, and comparison with PVV.

item.title: PIN PVV (VISA): PIN Verification Value Calculation
item.description: How VISA's PIN Verification Value (PVV) system works — PDK encryption, PVKI selection, PVV calculation and verification, comparison with PIN Offset.

item.title: ZKA: German Banking Standard for Session Keys & PIN
item.description: Understanding the ZKA standard — Session Key (SK-pac) derivation, PIN encryption, MAC calculation, and German payment terminal requirements.

item.title: VISA Certificate Validation: CA Keys, Issuer Certificates & EMV
item.description: How VISA certificate validation works — VSDC CA public keys, Issuer Certificate verification, Signed Data validation, and EMV certificate chain.

item.title: HSM Key Management: Thales, Futurex, Atalla & SafeNet
item.description: A complete overview of Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), key hierarchy, major vendors (Thales, Futurex, Atalla, SafeNet), and key transport standards.

item.title: DES & 3DES: The Legacy Encryption Standard in Payments
item.description: Understand DES and 3DES encryption — how they work, why DES is broken, and why 3DES remains deeply embedded in payment infrastructure.

item.title: AES Encryption Explained: Modes, Padding & Best Practices
item.description: A complete guide to AES encryption — key sizes, ECB/CBC/CTR/GCM modes, padding, IV best practices, and common mistakes to avoid.

item.title: RSA Encryption Guide: Keys, Padding & When to Use It
item.description: Everything you need to know about RSA — key sizes, OAEP vs PKCS#1 padding, hybrid encryption, and when to choose RSA vs ECC.

item.title: ECC & ECDSA: Elliptic Curve Cryptography Explained
item.description: Learn how Elliptic Curve Cryptography works — ECDSA signatures, ECDH key agreement, curve selection, and why ECC beats RSA for modern systems.

item.title: Hash Functions: MD5, SHA-256, BLAKE2 & When to Use Each
item.description: A practical guide to cryptographic hash functions — which are broken (MD5, SHA-1), which to use (SHA-256, BLAKE2), and how they're used in payment security.

item.title: ASN.1 & X.509 Certificates: A Practical Guide
item.description: Understand ASN.1 DER/PEM encoding, X.509 certificate structure, OIDs, and how to parse certificates and keys using online tools.

item.title: MAC Algorithms in Payment Security: ISO 9797, HMAC & CMAC
item.description: A complete guide to Message Authentication Codes in banking — ISO 9797-1, Retail MAC, HMAC-SHA256, AES-CMAC, and how they protect transactions.

item.title: ISO 8583 Payment Messages: Structure, Bitmap & Fields
item.description: Learn how ISO 8583 financial transaction messages work — MTI, bitmap parsing, data elements, response codes, and how PIN/MAC fit in.

item.title: Base64 Encoding Explained: Standard, URL-Safe & Use Cases
item.description: Everything about Base64 — how it works, standard vs URL-safe variants, use in JWTs and certificates, and common mistakes to avoid.

item.title: The Ultimate Guide to Key Splitting & KCV
item.description: Learn the mathematics behind XOR key splitting, understand Key Check Values (KCV), and master PCI DSS compliance for cryptographic key management.

item.title: TR-31 Key Block Format Explained
item.description: A comprehensive guide to ANSI X9.143 / TR-31 key block format, including structure, key usage codes, and practical encoding examples.

item.title: Understanding PIN Block Formats (ISO 9564)
item.description: Deep dive into ISO 9564 PIN block formats (0, 1, 2, 3, 4), their security properties, and when to use each format.

item.title: DUKPT Key Derivation: A Complete Tutorial
item.description: Master Derived Unique Key Per Transaction (DUKPT) from BDK to working keys, with step-by-step derivation examples.

item.title: How CVV/CVC Values are Calculated
item.description: Understand the cryptographic process behind card verification values, including CVV1, CVV2, iCVV, and dynamic CVV/CVC3.
